records.name: Confidence by Spotify
records.tagline: Build products at full speed, with both hands on the wheel
records.description: Confidence is a product intelligence platform built by Spotify. Spotify's approach to building products has always combined data with judgment and taste, and that scientific rigor is what Confidence brings to customers. Confidence is born from experimentation, but that’s now part of a wider story. Confidence analyzes your user signals, surfaces what's working, suggests the next move, and validates the hypothesis before it ships. You stay in the loop and approve the moves that matter.

records.name: OpenCouncil
records.tagline: Voice rooms where your team and AIs debate together
records.description: Put GPT, Gemini, Grok and your own agents in one live voice room with your team. They answer, push back on each other and never talk over you. A Scribe writes the decisions. Make the room public and anyone can listen, chat or take the stage. Works in your browser and Google Meet. Free to start: 2,000 credits, no card.

records.name: CSuite
records.tagline: All-in-one suite for AI content creation, fully private.
records.description: All-in-one AI suite for text, images, audio, and video — local or cloud models, on your machine, fully private. One-time payment. No login. No subscriptions.

records.name: Screenwell.ai
records.tagline: An AI interviewer that runs your first-round screening
records.description: Screenwell screens every applicant for you: Luna holds a short screening call through a link in your job ad, on Google Meet or Teams, and hands you a ranked shortlist with scores and quotes. 14 days free, no card needed.

records.name: CraveLens
records.tagline: See it. Crave it. Get it.
records.description: CraveLens is a Chrome extension that uses on-device AI to identify food in supported videos and selected webpage regions, then prepare personalized Swiggy carts for your review.

records.name: PixLate
records.tagline: Translate documents. Preserve artwork and layout.
records.description: PixLate translates PDFs, scans, and illustrated pages while preserving their artwork and layout. It combines AI translation with side-by-side review, correction tools, background processing, and PDF export. Projects stay on your device with pay-as-you-go credits.

records.name: Mira Tours
records.tagline: AI Walking Tour Guide
records.description: Mira is your AI tour guide. Walking audio tours, anywhere in the world: chat to build your own, or just start walking and hear the story of the places around you.

records.name: AURORA Lifeline
records.tagline: Know who a cyclone will cut off, before the roads close
records.description: Turns the official IMD cyclone bulletin into a district plan: which PHCs, hospitals and villages will lose road access, how likely, when, and what to move first. Gemini reads the bulletin, 1,000+ WeatherNext and ECMWF storm futures run over every road, and code inserts every number. Officers approve everything. Open source, misses published.

records.name: NoteHouse
records.tagline: Private lending, without the paperwork headache.
records.description: NoteHouse makes private lending easier. Whether you’re lending to family, helping a friend, or managing multiple loans, you shouldn’t need spreadsheets to keep track of everything. Create loan agreements, set repayment terms, track interest and payments, and see exactly what’s owed. Both borrowers and lenders stay on the same page, with all their documents and payment history in one place.

records.name: Acyclic
records.tagline: Rapid agent swarms for any agentic workflow
records.description: Hand Acyclic a task from the CLI, the dashboard, or a coding agent over MCP. It splits the work across many agents, each in its own instant fork of the workspace, and merges the results, so long agentic workflows finish in a fraction of the time. Bring your own model keys.

records.name: Spinachi AI
records.tagline: Personal AI health manager on Whatsapp
records.description: Your health, finally in one place. Forward your lab reports on WhatsApp. Spinachi sorts them for you and your family. See where you stand, how it's changing, and when your next test is due. No app. Never a diagnosis.

records.name: Keysi
records.tagline: See every shortcut of the app you're in
records.description: Hold ⌘ in any Mac app to see every keyboard shortcut, read live from its menus. Click a row to run it. Free, no time limit. Keysi Pro ($14.99 once) teaches the ones you keep missing: a quiet reminder, spaced-repetition drills, and "New" marks after updates.

records.name: Retriever AI
records.tagline: Free AI browser agent: find leads, reach out, apply to jobs
records.description: Retriever is a free AI browser agent that finishes work across websites. Ask it to find leads and send outreach, shortlist TikTok and Instagram creators for your next campaign, or apply to jobs. Run tasks in your own Chrome browser or in cloud browsers hosted by rtrvr. It beats OpenAI, Anthropic, and Muse on accuracy, runs 5x faster, and costs 300x less.

records.name: Pancake
records.tagline: The Vercel for GTM
records.description: Pancake is the Vercel for GTM. It gives you the building blocks to deploy any go-to-market idea from your favorite AI agent, such as Claude or Codex: a GTM Brain, sending infrastructure, and 40+ data providers and enrichment, all accessible through one MCP connection.

records.name: Tiden
records.tagline: Intent verification for coding agents
records.description: Tiden verifies your coding agents built what you actually asked for. Most checks run inside the session that wrote the code, so the tests agree with it by construction. Tiden keeps your intent as requirements that branch and merge like code, and checks every change against that record. The verdict comes from tests run in your environment; no model grades the diff. You decide what merges, and production errors trace back to the release. Works beside Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot.

records.name: Rambox
records.tagline: Ready-to-use workspaces as you switch tasks and contexts
records.description: A major Rambox redesign focused on making everyday work simpler, faster and easier to navigate. The new interface reduces friction and the number of clicks needed to move between apps, workspaces, tasks and contexts, while a redesigned onboarding experience makes Rambox easier to set up and understand. This release also adds faster access to what you need, improved tabs and context persistence, Unified Search, Quick View, Command Center and new focus tools.

records.name: Table Canon
records.tagline: Automated notes, searchable history, prep ideas for GMs
records.description: Focus on the session, not note taking. Simplify your prep time with a searchable memory-bank of what happened at your table. Table Canon turns uploaded game-night audio into a recap, outline, entity dossiers, searchable index, and prep ideas for tabletop RPG game masters. Memory evolves each session. No sign up required to get started, 6 hours of audio upload free! Message me that you saw the launch on Product Hunt and I’ll credit your account with an extra 10 hours.

records.name: AdAnt 2.0
records.tagline: Muse for Social Media Marketing
records.description: AdAnt AI is your proactive, 24/7 social media marketing team. The Strategist researches your niche on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Meta Ads and writes content strategies that work. The Creator turns every strategy into a batch of videos. The Analyst listens on X and Reddit for conversations worth joining. The Manager plans the calendar and posts. Built on the strategies our founding team used to generate 100M+ organic views and cut paid acquisition costs by 60% on average.

records.name: Nimble
records.tagline: SOTA Decision Model
records.description: Today, we are announcing Nimble-v4 and Nimble-v4-max which are pushing the frontier of decision models, outperforming Jev and other variants. On Decision Index public scores, our nimble-v4-max model and nimble-v4 models score +10.5 and +5.74 against Jev 1.13, making nimble-v4-max a top performing model. Beyond benchmarks, we have done a lot of internal evals, and see big improvements: 43% fewer mistakes than Jev, +50pp on model routing decisions, and so on. Try for free: console.bespokelabs.ai

records.name: Apple HomePod mini 2
records.tagline: Apple's tiny smart speaker, now built for Siri AI
records.description: HomePod mini 2 is Apple's next-generation compact smart speaker, built for a more personal Siri AI experience coming in a future update. It brings rich 360-degree sound, new colors, and Sound Glow lighting that responds to your music. Enjoy improved Mac audio, multiroom playback, and surround sound with Apple TV 4K, plus hands-free smart home control. Starting at $149, with preorders open now and availability from October 30.

records.name: Cloud Releases
records.tagline: Every AWS, Azure, GCP and Cloudflare update in one feed
records.description: 🔥 Cloud providers ship thousands of updates a year across separate blogs and changelogs. Cloud Releases puts AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and Cloudflare in one feed. Follow only the services you run, and spot retirements before they break something.

records.name: Make0 Brain
records.tagline: A memory store that works across all of your AI agents.
records.description: Make0 Brain is a personal memory store that works across ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible AI tools. AI agents can read and write to this memory and be in sync with your personal context. It is like dropbox but for memories - specifically built for agents to use. You can easily build your brain in just 2 minutes by importing your conversations from Claude, ChatGPT and even dropping your markdown files and documents.

records.name: EditUI
records.tagline: Point at your UI. Tell your coding agent what to change.
records.description: Explaining to cursor/claude code/codex UI changes: spacing is off, this card is too tall, that CTA is too loud, mobile looks weird.....is annoying. With EditUI you open your actual app/website in Chrome, click anything, leave a quick instruction, keep reviewing, then send the whole batch to Claude Code at once. No repo setup. Just a Chrome extension. Free and open source. No signup, no backend.

records.name: Hindsight 1.0 + Memlake
records.tagline: Open source memory for AI agents to learn from experience
records.description: Hindsight is open-source memory that lets AI agents learn from experience, #1 on every dataset of the Agent Memory Benchmark. Today it's 1.0, and the API is a promise. We're also launching Hindsight Memlake, a storage engine written in Rust that keeps agent memory in object storage: 100M memories at under 100 ms p99, with no database, consensus cluster or leader. Self-host it free, start on Hindsight Cloud with free credits, or run it in your own cloud with Enterprise.

records.name: RoleFit
records.tagline: Tailor every job application without starting from scratch
records.description: Hiring is slow, competition is tough, and tailoring every application takes time. RoleFit helps job seekers do more with less effort. Powered by Gemini AI, it analyzes job descriptions, identifies strengths and skill gaps, and creates personalized, ATS-friendly resumes, cover letters, and LinkedIn outreach messages. Refine documents with an AI copilot, export PDF/DOCX files, and track applications in one place. Built on Google Cloud Run.

records.name: SlashDocs by Razorpay
records.tagline: Self-hosted collaboration layer for agent-written HTML
records.description: SlashDocs is a self-hosted, open-source collaboration hub for AI agents. Agents publish real, interactive HTML documents, not plain text, and your team comments directly on the live doc. The agent reads that feedback and updates the same file in place, no new file every round, no feedback scattered across Slack or email. Self-hosted, agent-agnostic (works over MCP with any agent), and already powering about half of all documents created inside Razorpay.

records.name: WriterzRoom
records.tagline: Governed multi-agent AI content for regulated industries
records.description: Enterprise Content Intelligence platform. A multi-agent pipeline governed by vertical controls, template schema, and brand voice execution. Every generation is structured, validated, and review-ready before delivery. Runs fully serverless on Google Cloud Run.

records.name: Etchv
records.tagline: invisible forensic watermarks in images, PDFs and videos
records.description: Etchv embeds invisible forensic watermarks into images, PDFs, and short videos that survive screenshots, format changes, and compression. https://etchv.com/#try-it Key Features • A unique forensic watermark, written into the pixels by a neural net model, and made to survive resizing, cropping and compression. • Flexible Integration: Supports a direct developer API alongside official SDKs • No-Code Automation: Integrates with Zapier, n8n, and Make. • Live Demo: https://etchv.com/demo/trace

records.name: Elocuenti
records.tagline: Agentic commerce: sell on WhatsApp and AI assistants
records.description: Elocuenti is agentic commerce for WhatsApp and AI assistants. Your customers buy by chatting: on WhatsApp with your AI agent, or in ChatGPT and Claude, where their assistant searches your real catalog, builds the cart and places the order. Your agent learns from every customer, follows up, recovers carts and runs campaigns that send conversions back to Meta Ads.

records.name: FamRelay
records.tagline: Share facts between AI assistants — only what you approve
records.description: AI assistants are islands. Yours knows the plumber's coming Tuesday; your wife's knows nothing, and you're back to being the messenger. It's a neutral relay layer between AI assistants. Tell your assistant to share specific facts with specific people — "let Sam know the plumber's coming 8 to 10" — and their assistant picks it up. Nothing moves until you approve what's sent. It also works solo: add the connector to two or more assistants you own — Claude at work, ChatGPT at home — and relay facts

records.name: LegacyFixer
records.tagline: Python dependency security scans with optional fix PRs
records.description: Compared with Dependabot and Renovate, LegacyFixer focuses on security-first scanning of Python dependencies. It reports vulnerability findings even when an automated fix is not appropriate, and creates a fix pull request only when its policy and validation checks allow it. Each scan produces an explicit outcome, including detect-only (NO_ACTION) when no fix PR is created. LegacyFixer runs as a GitHub App on Google Cloud Run.

records.name: Blade
records.tagline: Find your first customers hiding in your inbox
records.description: You’ve spent years meeting people. A lot of those relationships are now buried in your inbox. Blade helps you find them again. Filter by how often you’ve emailed, when you last connected, and whether someone’s outside your company. With one click, send each person an individual email through your own Gmail. Whether you’re launching something, asking for feedback, or inviting people to an event, you’re starting with people who already know you.

records.name: T-Scriptor
records.tagline: Be in the lecture. T-Scriptor takes the notes.
records.description: T-Scriptor transcribes your lectures on your mac, So the audio never leaves it. After class it writes the notes: key concepts, what's due and the papers your professor mentioned. Before the exam it pulls the whole course together. The Mac app's live and you can download it on https://t-scriptor.app, the Iphone app is in Beta.

records.name: Reason
records.tagline: A state-of-the-art coding agent for cost efficiency
records.description: Reason is the best coding agent, in the cloud or locally. Give it a task and it writes code, runs tests and opens a pull request. Use Reason from the Mac app, terminal, web or Slack, with your choice of models and connected subscriptions. Start free on your own computer. Our published GPT-6 Astra evaluation scores 65.1 on the Coding Agent Index vs Codex’s 62.5, at 22% lower cost per solved task.

records.name: Exodus for Google Cloud Run
records.tagline: Upgrade any app to Cloud Run, with your coding agent
records.description: Cloud Run is Google's managed platform: no servers to look after, new copies in seconds under load, a bill only while your code works. Exodus takes your app there with your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor): it checks the app on your machine, shows what you pay today and on Cloud Run and what to change, by 50+ playbooks from real moves. Then the agent makes the move, task by task, or designs a new app for Cloud Run. Free and open source. Try it on your repo today.

records.name: Microsoft Maia 300
records.tagline: Microsoft’s own AI chip, headed to multi-gigawatts
records.description: Maia 300 is Microsoft’s next-generation AI inference platform, announced Oct 12, 2026. Per Microsoft, it’s built for long-context reasoning, low-latency conversation, and agents, with 8 HBM4 stacks, TSMC N2P compute chiplets, and 96-accelerator racks. Microsoft claims 40% more tokens per megawatt. Production starts in 2027, and Azure Maia scales to multi-gigawatt deployments, becoming the main inference system for Microsoft’s products.

records.name: Winq
records.tagline: Control your Mac with a look and a wink
records.description: Gaze focus switching: look at a window and it becomes the active one. Per-eye wink clicks: left wink and right wink are separate actions. Face-gesture shortcuts: map gestures to the actions you use most. Notch island: a small live indicator in the notch area shows what Winq detected. No extra hardware: it works with your Mac’s built-in camera, with a short guided calibration. Private by design: all face tracking runs on your Mac, and no video leaves the device.

records.name: Epherem
records.tagline: Find login and database flaws in your AI-built app
records.description: Epherem is a free source code security scanner for apps built with AI. It checks for common security issues involving authentication, database access, exposed API keys and vulnerable packages. Upload a ZIP or connect a GitHub repository to scan your app. Findings include plain-English explanations, suggested fixes and prompts you can paste into Claude Code, Lovable or Cursor. Reports can also be exported for review with your AI coding assistant, including issues the scanner couldn't verify.

records.name: Specreel
records.tagline: Product demos that update themselves
records.description: Paste your app's URL and Specreel walks it in a real browser, turning your key flows into narrated, shareable demos. Already on Playwright? It renders them from your test traces on every green build, so a demo can't go stale. Open-source CLI + hosted Cloud.

records.name: AirJelly
records.tagline: Your Proactive, Self-Organizing Second Brain
records.description: AirJelly is an always-on desktop AI agent that proactively captures your intent, organizes your tasks, and gets things done. By observing your on-screen activities, it knows who you are and what you're working on. It doesn't just spot your to-dos — it foresees what's next and acts. It also tracks your personal interactions, so you'll never miss a follow-up or forget a promise. Everything in your life is managed by AirJelly — freeing your time for what AI can't do, or simply for you to enjoy.

records.name: Orbora
records.tagline: Create personalized guided audio: meditation, breath, ASMR
records.description: Orbora generates audio talks tailored to you: guided meditations, breathwork, ASMR and short wisdom talks. Follow a guided path that walks you through what you need. Then shape the result: voice, length, tone, background sound and themes. AI writes and voices each talk from your choices. Save favorites, build your own library, and listen offline.

records.name: SupoClip
records.tagline: Open-source AI clipper: long videos into viral shorts
records.description: SupoClip turns long videos into vertical, captioned shorts. Paste a YouTube link or upload a file: AI transcribes it, picks the strongest 15–60s moments and scores each for virality, then crops 9:16 around the speaker and burns in word-synced captions and a hook title. Trim, split, merge and export for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. No watermarks. Open source (AGPL-3.0): self-host it free, or use the web app, iPhone app, REST API or MCP server.

records.name: Dashrendr
records.tagline: Build dashboards visually, embed them anywhere
records.description: Dashrendr is a visual dashboard builder made for embedding in your SaaS. Drag charts onto a grid and have a dashboard ready in minutes, then get data in two ways: connect a data source, or POST JSON from your backend. Your app already knows who's logged in, so each customer only sees their own data, with no row-level security to set up. And when someone wants a chart changed, anyone on the team can do it in the builder, no code or new deployment needed.

records.name: Payload Peek
records.tagline: Catch Webhooks. Inspect Payloads. Generate TypeScript.
records.description: A live webhook inbox for developers. Inspect HTTP requests, explore JSON payloads, and turn real events into TypeScript interfaces or Zod schemas. All in your browser, with no setup or account required.

records.name: daily.dev for agents
records.tagline: Where agents discover what's next
records.description: daily.dev is where millions of developers find out what's next. Now your agent can too. Connect Claude, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client to read personalized feeds, search posts, learn from discussions, save bookmarks and tune your feed. In addition, plugin marketplace and apps ecosystem. YOUR AGENTS CAN READ daily.dev NOW!!

records.name: Inferock
records.tagline: Serverless inference, with credits back for failed calls.
records.description: Get free signup credits to use all available models on Inferock. Bring your own keys: run your OpenAI, Claude or Gemini accounts, see where calls fail and what they cost, and get credits back on eligible failed calls. Serverless: pay-per-token LLM inference. Get signup credits to start using.

records.name: Diagramly
records.tagline: Sketch systems at the speed you think
records.description: Hand-drawn diagrams and cheat sheets you can type or describe. Write Client -> API -> DB, or ask the AI, and it's drawn and laid out. Six looks, from paper to blueprint to neon. Present as slides, embed in docs, export PNG, SVG or PDF. Free, no sign-up.

records.name: Kugel 3.5
records.tagline: Text-to-speech that beats any other Model out there
records.description: Kugel 3.5 beats four leading TTS models on 8 of 9 tests. It gets short words wrong at half the rate of the next-best model, reads long numbers exactly right 97.1% of the time and supports IPA. 5.25 cents a minute. Not on Kugel? Three lines to production.

records.name: Confidence by Spotify
records.tagline: Build products at full speed, with both hands on the wheel
records.description: Confidence is a product intelligence platform built by Spotify. Spotify's approach to building products has always combined data with judgment and taste, and that scientific rigor is what Confidence brings to customers. Confidence is born from experimentation, but that’s now part of a wider story. Confidence analyzes your user signals, surfaces what's working, suggests the next move, and validates the hypothesis before it ships. You stay in the loop and approve the moves that matter.

records.name: Progressive Dialer
records.tagline: Smart Outbound Call Automation for Contact Centers
records.description: This Progressive Dialer solution helps contact centers manage outbound campaigns by placing calls at a controlled pace based on agent availability. It helps reduce idle time, organize lead calling, and maintain a smoother flow between agents and contacts. Explore Solution: https://kingasterisk.com/services/progressive-dialer/

records.name: Easy Recipe Card Maker
records.tagline: Paste a recipe video or web link. Get a beautiful card.
records.description: Turn any YouTube cooking video or noisy recipe webpage into a clean, printable recipe card in seconds. Paste a link, get ingredients and step-by-step instructions instantly — free to try, no sign up required.

records.name: Best Automation Tools for Freelancers
records.tagline: Automate repetitive tasks and save time as a freelancer
records.description: Discover the best automation tools for freelancers in 2026. This practical guide explores tools for automating repetitive tasks, managing workflows, organizing client work, and improving productivity. Compare useful options, understand where automation fits into your business, and choose tools that reduce manual work without adding unnecessary complexity.

records.name: Globber
records.tagline: Block spam calls by pattern, not by number
records.description: Globber is a free, open-source Android call blocker that screens by pattern — prefixes, wildcards, regex — before your phone rings. Five match types, reject/silence/voicemail actions, block log. No INTERNET permission, no ads, no accounts. 100% on-device. MIT.

records.name: The AI Agent Marketplace
records.tagline: Expert-built Claude Skills for real work
records.description: A marketplace of expert-built Claude Skills based on real professional workflows. Download portable SKILL.md files for SEO, content, analytics, marketing, business and WordPress. Each skill gives Claude a structured process, quality checks and clear deliverables. One subscription includes the full library, new releases and commercial usage for internal projects or client work.

records.name: HookWatcher
records.tagline: Debug webhooks. Inspect every request. Forward to localhost.
records.description: HookWatcher helps developers capture, inspect, debug, replay, and forward webhooks in real time. Monitor requests, troubleshoot integrations, and securely tunnel localhost endpoints to receive webhooks from external services—all from one developer-friendly dashboard.

records.name: Viki
records.tagline: Turn astrology into action. Build the life you want.
records.description: Your horoscope tells you what might happen. Viki helps you decide what to do next. Combining your birth chart, numerology and today’s sky, Viki turns spiritual insight into daily Power Moves, manifestation practices and routines you can follow. Explore your patterns, a 13-month calendar and deep numerology. Add friends, read their portraits and chat. Groups and encrypted chat are coming soon. Free to start.

records.name: SubGemini
records.tagline: AI Video Subtitling & Translation Studio powered by Gemini
records.description: SubGemini is an AI-powered video subtitling and translation studio built with Google Gemini (Gemini 3.8 Flash & Gemini 2.5 Pro/Flash). Upload video files or paste cloud links to transcribe speech, translate subtitles into English, Simplified or Traditional Chinese, apply custom glossary terms, style typography, downloadSRT, and hardcode subtitles directly into video with FFmpeg.

records.name: Knowledge Composer
records.tagline: Make building blocks of complex thoughts, stored as markdown
records.description: Knowledge Composer for macOS is a production studio for thinkers, animators, gamers, and world builders. Make publications, simulations, and games. Create maps of elements customized with text, scripts, animation and design layers including Rive animation, Lottie animations, and web views. Script with interpreted Dart. Use Element-Oriented Substitution to compose text from element properties. Publish HTML and view with built in web server. Edit structures from the map or in your favorite IDE.

records.name: Snippet Include
records.tagline: Include external PHP, HTML & JS files in Joomla articles.
records.description: Snippet Include is a lightweight open-source Joomla plugin designed for developers and site managers to effortlessly insert external PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files into articles and modules using simple shortcodes. Unlike heavy page builders, it provides a clean, secure, and zero-performance-impact solution for managing dynamic code snippets across Joomla web properties.

records.name: Simple Agent Store
records.tagline: Dead simple storage for your AI agents
records.description: Save notes, todos, contacts, and JSON with one AI agent. Retrieve them with another. Simple Agent Store gives your connected agents one shared store via MCP, with a web viewer to inspect your data. Use managed Cloud or self-host the Apache-2.0 core. Five operations: put, get, list, search, delete. Your agents handle language; the store keeps the objects you ask them to save.

records.name: QueryBurst
records.tagline: The Workspace for Improving Brand Visibility in AI Search
records.description: QueryBurst is a workspace for modelling multi-turn customer journeys through AI search to discover where your brand enters, influences, and leaves the conversation — and why. Create target personas and branching conversations, explore how context changes answers, and inspect the research process from query fan-out to source selection and citations. It's like stepping inside your customer's AI conversations to see what shapes the answers they receive. Think people and conversations, not prompts.

records.name: petiteimg: compress, resize, convert
records.tagline: Compress, resize, crop and convert images, free or via API
records.description: petiteimg is a no-fuss image tool: drop a JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF and compress, resize, crop or convert it in seconds, free in the browser. Choose Optimal quality for a smart default, or Super saver to squeeze out every last byte. Images are only scaled down, never upscaled. Developers get a simple API with batch processing, larger files (now up to 100MB) and programmatic access, to plug image optimization straight into any app or pipeline.

records.name: ImiHub
records.tagline: AI video generation & face swap, made simple
records.description: ImiHub is an AI content platform for video generation and face swap — make product videos, ads, and social clips in minutes, with a credit-based pricing model and a full API.

records.name: Kiddofest
records.tagline: Celebrate more, remember forever.
records.description: Kiddofest helps families capture more of a kids' party, including the moments the host might otherwise miss. Guests can take part in photo challenges, leave voice messages and wishes, and share what they capture throughout the celebration. Instead of ending up across different phones and group chats, everything stays together in one private place to revisit long after the party. Hosts can also use RSVPs if they need them, but they're completely optional.

records.name: ASL Keycloak Console
records.tagline: Reach your private Keycloak console over approved SSH
records.description: ASL Keycloak Console is an independent Android administration tool for opening a private Keycloak console through an approved SSH connection. It is intended for administrators who already control the required server and access configuration. A compatible SSH server and private loopback HTTP listener are required. The app does not supply hosted identity infrastructure, create an identity service, or grant administrative authorization merely by being installed.

records.name: Blood Snap - Blood Pressure and Glucuose
records.tagline: log blood pressure, blood sugar & weight
records.description: Blood Snap is a free personal diary to log blood pressure, blood sugar, and weight from a home blood pressure monitor, cuff, glucometer, or scale. Voice or snap a reading, see blood pressure and glucose charts of numbers you entered, export PDF. Not a medical device.

records.name: editpdf.tools
records.tagline: 100% secure, client-side PDF tools. Zero server uploads.
records.description: A completely private PDF utility suite. Our 12 free tools run entirely locally in your browser, meaning your confidential documents never touch our servers. Need advanced editing? Our Pro version uses secure zero retention serverless processing.

records.name: Chatnimal
records.tagline: The cutest desktop pet that never reads your code
records.description: Chatnimal is a knitted desktop pet for macOS that keeps you company while your AI agent works. Turn on AI integration and it hooks into Claude Code and Cursor: it types along while the agent thinks and jumps to celebrate when the turn is done. Hooks send only a one-word status over local loopback (127.0.0.1), never prompts or code. Plus a 25-min Pomodoro, break reminders, 10 handcrafted pets and mochi-drag physics. Native Swift 6, macOS 14+. One-time $5.99, no subscription.

records.name: CardValue.ai
records.tagline: AI-powered card valuations in seconds.
records.description: Hey Product Hunt! I'm Sem, and I built CardValue.ai to help you discover what your Pokémon cards are worth. Upload a photo to identify your card, check its market price, and analyze its condition with AI-powered grading insights, all directly in your browser. Whether you're checking a rare pull or going through an old collection, CardValue.ai makes Pokémon card analysis simple. It's completely free, with no subscription needed. I'd love to hear your feedback! Try it at https://cardvalue.ai

records.name: DocuSahayak
records.tagline: Simple Tools for Photos, Signatures and PDFs
records.description: DocuSahayak is a handy Android app for everyday document and form preparation. English (US/UK), Dutch, German and French. Design inspired by Cellarius' 1660 star atlas.

records.name: Kumiho Memory
records.tagline: Shared memory for agent teams, with the why intact
records.description: Kumiho is a belief-based cognitive memory layer for teams running agents across functions. It preserves shared context, decisions, code_why, and how beliefs change—so every agent can build on the team's reasoning instead of starting from isolated chat history.

records.name: PamsBeyond
records.tagline: Intelligent all in one travel workspace & itinerary builder
records.description: PamsBeyond is an all-in-one travel workspace combining AI guidance with practical trip planning. Map multi-city routes, track live budgets, check visa rules, auto-generate interactive charts, and export a complete PDF travel portfolio

records.name: ShownInAI
records.tagline: See if AI assistants recommend your brand
records.description: ShownInAI checks the buyer questions people ask AI assistants in your category, shows which competitors get recommended, which sources are cited, and gives a fix plan. Free scan; plans from $79/mo. Code LAUNCH40 = 40% off first month.

records.name: HI3D.cc
records.tagline: Turn a photo, or a kid's drawing, into a 3D model
records.description: HI3D.cc turns one photo into a 3D model: 4K geometry with PBR maps, a repaired STL and 3MF for printing, or a game-ready mesh with auto-rig. Check a clay preview in 2–3 minutes first. Credits from $12; commercial use with purchased credits.

records.name: aifree.dev
records.tagline: Free AI credits, free tiers and student deals in one list
records.description: 190+ free AI offers: LLM API credits and free tiers, coding assistants, image, voice and video tools, GPUs, and student and startup programs. Each one shows what you actually get, the catch, whether a card is required, and when it was last checked.

records.name: Patchbay
records.tagline: One local endpoint for every model you have.
records.description: One local endpoint for every model you have. OpenAI- & Anthropic-compatible proxy + menu-bar app for ChatGPT/Codex, Claude Pro/Max, Grok, OpenRouter and API keys.

records.name: Mokxi
records.tagline: A free electronics simulator that runs in your browser
records.description: Wire a circuit on a breadboard, write the C++, press Run. Mokxi simulates an Arduino Uno, ESP32, Raspberry Pi Pico or STM32 in real time, right in your browser, with nothing to install. Every board and part is free. Circuit Doctor spots wiring mistakes before you fry a real part, and teachers get free lessons, classes, login cards and automatic checks. When it works, send the same sketch to a real board.

records.name: LumaFlow
records.tagline: Find Your Financial Rhythm
records.description: LumaFlow brings budgets, bills, savings goals, debt tracking, spending insights and financial planning together in one personal finance app. Android Early Access is available now through Google Play Closed Testing, with iOS planned.

records.name: Kugel 3.5
records.tagline: Text-to-speech that beats any other Model out there
records.description: Kugel 3.5 beats four leading TTS models on 8 of 9 tests. It gets short words wrong at half the rate of the next-best model, reads long numbers exactly right 97.1% of the time and supports IPA. 5.25 cents a minute. Not on Kugel? Three lines to production.

records.name: AskFomo
records.tagline: Free and cheap things to do in a City
records.description: Fomo finds everything free and cheap in a City (Currently Edinburgh only): free comedy, £1 theatre, pub quizzes and student and local deals, all updated daily. Ask it things like “cheap date night in Leith on Friday” and get real answers on a map. Free, no sign-up needed.

records.name: FlowProof
records.tagline: AI Fullstack Engineer, now self-healing on Google Cloud Run
records.description: Rebuilt serverless for the Cloud Run Hackathon: FlowProof now deploys and heals itself on Google Cloud Run. The same AI fullstack engineer that turns SOPs into continuously tested workflows — executing steps in a browser, detecting documentation drift, and recovering broken paths — now scales to zero and spins up on demand.

records.name: Circes
records.tagline: The AI decision layer for Amazon sellers
records.description: Circes connects your Amazon advertising, inventory, pricing, and margins, then recommends the next move with the evidence behind it: the numbers, the tradeoffs, and the reason to hold. You approve, Circes makes the change, then checks the outcome once attribution settles. Built for brands, agencies, and the operators who run them.

records.name: Vourchrpay
records.tagline: The Easiest way to issue and redeem digital rewards
records.description: Send thousands of digital vouchers in seconds, make redemption effortless, and track every reward from delivery to redemption.

records.name: Sonikr Media Hub
records.tagline: A private home for the media you own.
records.description: Sonikr is building a local-first private media hub for organizing, enjoying and accessing the music and media you own. Start with music on Windows and Mac.

records.name: Meowslim
records.tagline: A cozy, ad-free Quran and prayer app with a cat mascot
records.description: Meowslim is a Quran and prayer companion with no ads. Read the full 30-juz Quran with tafsir and verse-by-verse murottal, get prayer times and adhan alarms for your location, find the qibla, and count dhikr on a digital tasbih. A worship tracker with daily streaks and XP helps you keep a routine, and Musa the cat keeps you company. Free on Android, with desktop apps for Windows, macOS and Linux. In English and Indonesian.

records.name: 4Couple
records.tagline: Couples app for mood check-ins, date ideas and movie nights
records.description: Most couples apps are a deck of questions you forget in a week. 4couple is the one you open every day. Check in on how you both really feel, get help finding the right words with a coach that remembers your story, plan a date that fits tonight's budget, and stop scrolling on two couches: swipe until you both match on a movie. Private chats stay private. One subscription for both of you.

records.name: Sports Nutrition By Max Muscle
records.tagline: Student Athlete Nutrition for Peak Sports Performance
records.description: Max Muscle Nutrition helps student athletes understand the importance of Student Athlete Nutrition for supporting active lifestyles and sports performance. A balanced diet with adequate protein, carbohydrates, healthy fats, vitamins, and minerals can support energy needs, muscle recovery, and overall wellness. Whether you participate in school sports, college athletics, or regular training, choosing appropriate nutrition products alongside healthy meals can help you meet your fitness goals.

records.name: FrostBox
records.tagline: Know what's in your freezer before food goes to waste
records.description: FrostBox keeps your freezer, food stock and home preparedness organised. Scan barcodes, track expiry dates, see what should be used first, plan meals and share the household. The free version is genuinely useful, while Pro is an optional 49 DKK one-time purchase instead of a subscription. Available for iPhone, iPad and Android.

records.name: DueNest
records.tagline: Private reminders for important dates abroad
records.description: DueNest is a free-beta reminder tool for people living across borders. Enter dates you have confirmed yourself, choose your timezone and reminder intervals, and review the schedule. No passport scans, document uploads, immigration-status checks, or legal deadline calculations. Keep a separate backup for critical dates.

records.name: GreenCheckmark - Digitally signed photo
records.tagline: Just like signed PDF files, you can verify their originality
records.description: *** AI slops are obscuring authentic photos and videos. *** GreenCheckmark allows creators to make verifiable content to raise the trust level. 1) Sellers/Realtors: Verifiable photos make their listing stand-out. What you see is what you REALLY get. 2) Newsrooms: Minimize the need to send reporters to the field to take trusted photos, which costs money & time. 3) Citizen Journalism: Assure their viewers that the photos are authentic, captured directly from camera, and unmodified by human or AI.

records.name: Hoodli
records.tagline: Your local neighborhood all in one place.
records.description: What you can do on Hoodli: 🏷️ Buy and sell with neighbors, and grab free stuff from curb alerts before it's gone 🛠️ Find local pros your neighbors actually recommend 📅 See what's happening: events, garage sales and places to explore around town 🏠 Find housing and jobs close to home 💬 Ask your neighbors: recommendations, lost pets, questions about town It's free to join, and your email stays private. Neighbors message each other right on Hoodli.

records.name: Aftercall
records.tagline: Meeting notes that write themselves, privately on your Mac
records.description: Aftercall notices when a Zoom, Teams, Meet or WhatsApp call starts, transcribes both sides on your Mac, and writes the notes: a topic-by-topic summary with source links, action items, your own notes and the full transcript. Free; speaks English and Hebrew.

records.name: Mumbai Diana
records.tagline: Elite Escort Services Sector In Mumbai
records.description: Mumbai escorts and call girls in Mumbai. Independent listings in Andheri, Bandra, Juhu, Powai, Colaba, Worli, BKC and Navi Mumbai. Direct WhatsApp, cash after meeting. 21+ only.

records.name: MAX TEMP MAIL
records.tagline: Reduce you spam mails any more
records.description: Create a free temporary email instantly with MAX TEMP MAIL. Receive emails online without registration and protect your primary inbox from spam.

records.name: inkPad
records.tagline: Read PDFs. Write freely. Learn better.
records.description: Inkpad is a handwriting-first note-taking app for Android tablets, built for people who learn by reading, writing, and thinking on paper. Read PDFs, annotate directly on the page with your stylus, and keep your notes organized in one place. Whether you're studying lecture slides, marking up textbooks, or working through research papers, Inkpad helps you stay focused on what you're learning. If you study with a stylus, give Inkpad a try and help us build a note-taking experience that feels right.

records.name: Scrapoint
records.tagline: Extract · Enrich · Export at scale
records.description: Scrapoint helps sales teams, lead-generation agencies, and recruiters collect LinkedIn and Sales Navigator data, organize prospect records, and export structured datasets. With Data Vault and QuickEnrich integration, streamline prospect research and build more efficient B2B data workflows.

records.name: SelfCook
records.tagline: Your personal cookbook — save recipes, cook step by step
records.description: SelfCook is a personal cookbook for iPhone. Save family recipes and your own creations — ingredients, steps, photos, and little tips. Then cook in step-by-step mode, where every step has its own timer. No more guessing what you did last time. Share recipes with friends. Good food, slow living. Free, no account needed.

records.name: AskIt
records.tagline: Turn Any Business into an AI Agent Ecosystem
records.description: AskIt gives your chain its own AI salesperson on your website, phone, WhatsApp, in store and inside ChatGPT. Free demo on your catalog in 48 hours.

records.name: Motion studio
records.tagline: Next-Gen 4D Multi-Tier Parallax, AI Scene & Offline Video
records.description: Morphs Motion Studio is a high-performance, lightweight 4D live wallpaper and video compositor designed for Android, Utilizing an air-gapped, multi-layer depth engine, Motion Studio isolates subjects in real time, generates atmospheric particle fields, and simulates volumetric gyroscopic perspective—allowing you to transform any static photograph or AI scene into an interactive 3D/4D experience and export seamless 10-second looping MP4 clips 100% locally on your device.

records.name: Vesper
records.tagline: Turn Jira data into priorities, risks and next steps
records.description: Vesper turns Jira data into ranked priorities, risks and next steps. It traces cross-team blocker chains and gives developers, product owners and leaders role-specific views built from the same facts. Every number links to its Jira evidence, with copy-ready escalations and Excel exports. It flags stale data and low confidence. No LLM is involved: processing stays within Atlassian Forge and respects each user’s Jira permissions.

records.name: Coolie
records.tagline: AI GTM Agents
records.description: AI GTM agents that finds signal based, ICP-fit leads like competitor users, expired trials, recent churns, or upcoming renewals plus 40+ signals & research each with 300+ deep third level insights to write hyper-relevant sequence for Email and LinkedIn on auto-pilot

records.name: DomainKit
records.tagline: Find domain names worth owning with domainkit.co
records.description: Describe your idea in a sentence. DomainKit invents brandable names, scores them for fit and pronunciation, and live-checks which domains you can register right now, with prices. No more falling for a name that's taken. Free to start, no card needed.

records.name: Batch Photo Compressor & Crop
records.tagline: Batch resize, compress & remove backgrounds for online shops
records.description: Batch Photo Compressor & Crop is an all-in-one, 100% offline workflow tool built for e-commerce sellers, creators, and photographers. ⚡ WHAT YOU CAN DO IN BULK: • Process: Bulk resize, compress, and crop hundreds of images instantly. • AI Power: Wipe backgrounds with smart precision and add custom watermarks. • Presets: Tap pre-configured ratios optimized for Etsy, Shopify, and Vinted. 🔒 SECURE & LOCAL: Set target file sizes (KB) or convert to WebP/PNG securely on-device.

records.name: PrettiNotch
records.tagline: A second brain hiding in your notch
records.description: pretti-notch learns from what you do, answers anything about your work, writes in your voice, and reminds you of what you promised. Free for macOS.

records.name: Pico Convert
records.tagline: Convert Any File Drop a file and pick what to turn it into
records.description: Convert files online for free — images, PDFs, documents, spreadsheets, audio, video and archives. Fast, secure file converter, no sign-up required. 461 converters. https://picoconvert.com

records.name: Litjob
records.tagline: AI job agent that tailors your CV for every job
records.description: Litjob finds jobs that match your CV, tailors your CV and cover letter for each role, and sends your best matches to WhatsApp. For job seekers worldwide.

records.name: Free Web Games
records.tagline: Play free web games inside your browser. No download!
records.description: Free browser games with no download and no account. Play 843 original puzzle, arcade, card and racing games straight in your browser.

records.name: AutoShade
records.tagline: AI powered non-destructive RAW photo editing tool
records.description: AutoShade turns the picture an image model generated from your RAW into an editable develop recipe, and renders every AI proposal through one deterministic Rust engine.

records.name: Hide Photos: Secret Album
records.tagline: encrypted, offline, and away from the cloud.
records.description: Hide Photos is a privacy-focused photo vault that keeps your personal photos and videos encrypted directly on your iPhone. No account, no cloud uploads, and no ads. Unlike a regular hidden album, it offers a separate PIN, Face ID protection, private albums, and an optional decoy vault. Your private files stay under your control.

records.name: Hive
records.tagline: Coding agents that don't clock out
records.description: Hive is open-source infrastructure that gives every coding agent a persistent runtime — terminal, workspace and context that survive disconnects, reboots and closed laptops.

records.name: FounderNear.me
records.tagline: Find Founders and Events around your area
records.description: FounderNear.me is a live map of startup founders near you. See who's building within walking distance, poke them and meet in the real world.

records.name: Idle. — Reclaim Your Screen Time
records.tagline: The screen time app that wants you to leave.
records.description: Sign up during launch week: the trial is 30 days. A screen-time app that doesn't lock your phone. Press start, lock the screen, put the phone down. Time away counts as reclaimed. Idle. is a mirror that does not judge. It doesn't track, reward, or shame you. It only shows the time you took back. It wants you to leave. From Wanderer to Returner, there are others on it. One or two companions. Three lamps a day. Four short practices. No ads. Nothing can be broken.

records.name: Atmos Orbit
records.tagline: your powerfull ai coding buddy for roblox games
records.description: roblox game programing just got more easy now you can describe what game you want and the ai builds it

records.name: GetCybr
records.tagline: vCISO & compliance services at AI scale, built for MSPs
records.description: GetCybr is the AI platform for MSPs, MSSPs and consultancies running vCISO, GRC and compliance services across every client. AI agents handle the repeatable work (assessments, roadmaps, risk registers, evidence and reporting) while your team reviews, sets direction and owns the client relationship. - Multi-client vCISO dashboard - SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIS2, DORA, NIST CSF, HIPAA, CMMC - Risk quantification and TPRM - White-label client reports Start free with a 20-control gap assessment.

records.name: CareerMatch
records.tagline: Free AI Resume Analyzer & Job Matcher
records.description: CareerMatch compares your resume with a job description, identifies matching skills and keyword gaps, and helps you prepare for interviews. Free, private, and browser-based.

records.name: IP Clean Check
records.tagline: Is your proxy or VPS IP clean? Residential vs datacenter
records.description: Bought a "residential" proxy or a new VPS? IP Clean Check tells you in one click whether sites will see a real home/mobile user or a datacenter. It cross-checks 2 IP databases, gives a 0–100 clean score, explains every deduction (hosting ASN, proxy/VPN/Tor flags), and runs browser leak checks (timezone, WebRTC, language). Look up any IP or call the free JSON API (batch up to 10). Built for the Cloud Run Hackathon: zero-dependency Python, deployed with one gcloud run deploy, scales to zero.

records.name: Clipboard Manager - ClipBox
records.tagline: Your clipboard history, synced across Apple devices
records.description: ClipBox brings your clipboard history together across Mac, iPhone and iPad. Save text, links, images and snippets; find them with advanced search; restore deleted clips for 30 days; and sync with iCloud. On Mac, queue clips and paste them in order.

records.name: Lorivelle
records.tagline: Turn Mac screen recordings into polished product demos
records.description: Record your screen on Mac with automatic click zooms. Refine your recording with clean cuts, camera layouts and custom backgrounds, then share a polished demo.
